name: heretic
description: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models
one_liner: A tool that automatically strips the built-in safety guardrails out of open AI language models.
buyer: An AI safety or red-team researcher studying how models behave once their guardrails are removed, to help build better defenses.
business_use_cases: An AI safety research lab studies unfiltered model outputs to publish findings on failure modes.
A red-team consultancy stress-tests a client's fine-tuned model after guardrail removal to find gaps before attackers do.
A hobbyist builds a personal 'uncensored' local chatbot for private use.

money_ideas.idea: Offer red-teaming and guardrail-hardening consulting to companies shipping their own fine-tuned models.

steal_this: This isn't a weekend business — it's a legitimate research and red-teaming tool, but reselling 'uncensored' models built with it collides with hosting and provider terms of service fast.
